subject.title: All .large bubbles should have scrollable body regardless of truncation

question: Should tall native messages open an explicit full-message reader, use an independently scrollable body inside every large bubble, or retain transcript-only scrolling?
rationale: Each option changes touch gestures, accessibility, selection, and scroll anchoring across iOS and Android; source inspection cannot determine the intended interaction model.

options.title: Use Explicit Reader
options.body: Open tall messages in a dedicated bounded reader while keeping the transcript's gesture and anchoring model simple.

options.title: Use Nested Body Scroll
options.body: Make every large bubble body independently scrollable and accept the additional nested-gesture and accessibility complexity.

options.title: Keep Transcript Scrolling
options.body: Retain current transcript-only scrolling and close this request as not planned.

recommendation.title: Use Explicit Reader
recommendation.body: Open tall messages in a dedicated bounded reader while keeping the transcript's gesture and anchoring model simple.

likelyOwner.reason: They already provided product-level review on this exact issue and are the strongest available routing candidate for the cross-platform interaction choice.
